market.summary: The firm open did not hold: Sensex fell 1,484 points (-1.77%) and Nifty 451 points (-1.75%) to 25,350, the worst day in weeks, as banks and metals were sold after an 11% November rally. IT was the only sector up. Tuesday 24 Nov is a holiday, so today's close is what your exit rules use until Wednesday. All seven open trades stay on their plans tonight; GROWW and TIPSMUSIC are closest to their next exit levels.

points.text: Bank Nifty -3.17% to 62,585 a week after its record; HDFC Bank -3.3%, Axis -4.0%, IndusInd -4.0%. Nifty Metal -3.7% (Tata Steel about -8% after agreeing to buy a 26.6% promoter stake in APL Apollo, which fell about 21%).
Nifty IT +1.7% was the only major sector up (TCS +3.5%, Tech Mahindra +1.8%).
India VIX 18.02 (+4.0%); MCX gold about +2.5%; Brent about $89 and easing. Reasons given: profit-taking, the late-week US AI sell-off and weaker FII sentiment.

market.watch: Wednesday's open after the holiday: a second down day on volume in banks/financials would test GROWW's 20 EMA first. Market regime still reads RISK-ON on the engine.
